description: Source code implementing the GeneralNames class and related functions for parsing and handling GeneralName structures in X.509 certificates, including IP address handling and ASN.1 parsing.

classes.name: GeneralNames
classes.description: Represents a collection of GeneralName types parsed from ASN.1 DER encoding, including methods for creation and parsing.

methods.name: GeneralNames::Create
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from DER-encoded data, validating the sequence structure.

methods.name: GeneralNames::CreateFromValue
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from a DER input value, parsing individual GeneralName entries.
